model.predict: rating = intercept + sum_k coef[k] * (axis[k] - axisMean[k]) / axisSd[k]

validation.CAVEAT: axesUsed was chosen by searching subsets on this same LOO score, so these numbers are optimistic. The unbiased pre-registered 7-axis model scored LOO RMSE 0.657 vs baseline 0.782. Treat ~0.66 as the honest error, not 0.61.

interpretation.dominantAxis: one latent dimension does nearly all the work: fresh/savory/high-toned vs ripe/oaky/full-bodied
interpretation.evidence: single-axis model (aromaticLift alone, LOO RMSE 0.637) beats the full 7-axis model (0.657); the 7 axes are highly collinear
interpretation.likes: aromatic lift, savory/earthy character, moderate tannin, low new oak, non-jammy fruit
interpretation.dislikes: new oak, jammy ripeness, heavy body
interpretation.unresolved: two Sangiovese-based Tuscans rated in opposite directions (Sassarello 5, Chianti Classico 2.5) and are the two largest errors; not explained by these axes
